How to File a Discrimination Claim - With or Without an Attorney!

You have the right to earn a living – in a workplace free of unlawful discrimination. But what happens when your employer violates the law? Can you or should you file a discrimination claim? How can you continue to earn a living and provide for your family while your employer is discriminating against you? The situation may feel hopeless. You might feel powerless. But you’re not.
